input_zh: 同运行日 Reading Recovery：上游 Queue Owner 已于 13:07:09+08:00 将 Q-20260904-03 的 Codex 来源身份从无效 SHA 0650d6d1ca451b67009a0a22b97d1847febb9b2 正式修正为权威 Maintainer Commit 0650d6d1ca451b67009b3969a82b87e76979975f。Reading 控制保持 Scheduler V3.0、Worker Control v1.3.0、Generated Reading Prompt v1.0.0；其声明且此前已确定性核验的 SHA-256 为 9ad93d7f4cd7859fc0b32fa9b3b9e2b836a177c889addcc67d0b4fdc3261d7b5，并读取全部 5 个 Required Source。Recovery Worker Claimed 已于 13:07:41+08:00 持久记录；此后 Reading 只消费修正后的同日 Research Plan，以及该 Plan 选中/交叉引用的两个权威 Maintainer Commit。
workResult: Skill 03 completed source-bounded Deep Reading for the only selected same-date object Q-20260904-03 after the owning Queue stage repaired its source identity. OpenAI Codex commit 0650d6d1ca451b67009b3969a82b87e76979975f preserves one or more WWW-Authenticate challenges after silent OAuth recovery fails and converts the interruption into a failed MCP tool-call result carrying mcp/www_authenticate metadata rather than automatically replaying the rejected call; its integration coverage observes the agent event stream and constrains the rejected MCP tools/call to one occurrence. Google ADK commit cb0eb2288bfe6536bd6e98f0601d3736844062ca fixes an independent confirmation-pause recurrence path by setting tool_context.actions.skip_summarization=True when an MCP call requests confirmation, preventing the pause result from returning to the model loop and re-invoking the tool; targeted tests cover both constant and callable confirmation policies. Reading distinguishes bounded silent recovery, human-confirmation resume, model reinvocation and a genuinely new tool invocation, and preserves the negative boundary that neither implementation proves exactly-once external effects, distributed deduplication or that a remote side effect could not have committed before an observed failure. No Research Analysis, article writing, visualization, Production or Publication was performed in Reading.
workResult_zh: 在拥有内容权的 Queue Stage 完成 Source Identity 修复后，Skill 03 对同日唯一 Selected Object Q-20260904-03 完成了有来源边界的 Deep Reading。OpenAI Codex 提交 0650d6d1ca451b67009b3969a82b87e76979975f 在 Silent OAuth Recovery 失败后保留一个或多个 WWW-Authenticate Challenge，并把中断转换为携带 mcp/www_authenticate Metadata 的 Failed MCP Tool-call Result，而不是自动重放被拒绝的调用；其 Integration Test 观察 Agent Event Stream，并把被拒绝的 MCP tools/call 约束为一次。Google ADK 提交 cb0eb2288bfe6536bd6e98f0601d3736844062ca 修复了独立的 Confirmation-pause 重入路径：当 MCP Call 请求确认时设置 tool_context.actions.skip_summarization=True，阻止 Pause Result 回到 Model Loop 并再次调用工具；Targeted Tests 同时覆盖常量与 Callable Confirmation Policy。Reading 明确区分 Bounded Silent Recovery、Human-confirmation Resume、Model Reinvocation 与真正的新 Tool Invocation，并保留负面边界：两项实现都不能证明 External Effect Exactly-once、Distributed Deduplication，也不能证明远端副作用在客户端观察到 Failure 前绝未提交。Reading 阶段未执行 Research Analysis、文章写作、可视化、Production 或 Publication。
